info.title: UFMS Business Management Suite API
info.description:
Multi-tenant business management REST API.

Auth: POST /api/v1/auth/login → Bearer token (SHA-256,HttpOnly cookie).
All tenant-scoped routes require a session; access is enforced by explicit permission codes and PostgreSQL Row Level Security.
Versioning: /api/v1/* (frozen); future breaking changes under /api/v2.
Platform: /api/v1/platform/* requires platform_admin.
Worker: /api/v1/queue/jobs exposes job status for the in-process queue (swap to Redis in production).
Storage: /api/v1/storage/* uses object-storage adapter (S3/GCS/Azure) with signed URLs; console provider is metadata-only (Rule 4).
